title: Bram and the Sigil
author: Vesper Zhou
blurb: Freya Kavanagh, a thief who steals memories, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
